title: O002-D1 Future-Change Prediction Attack
classification: Exploratory/post-primary adversarial test. CASE level-prediction outcomes are known; future-change outcomes are not.
purpose: Test the strongest alternative explanation of the baseline-dominance result: physiology may predict changes/deviations in future affect even if it cannot improve absolute level prediction over persistence.

design.change_target: delta_y = future target y_axis at horizon h minus prior_axis from the predictor row.
design.physiology_features: context features + exact frozen 29 O002 peripheral features

ridge.tuning: training-only GroupKFold by subject, up to 4 folds

design.evaluation: Simultaneous unseen-person × unseen-video cells. For each test subject and video, training excludes all rows from that subject AND all rows from that video. Video identity omitted.
metrics: delta_zero_phys = MAE(zero)-MAE(physiology), positive favors physiology for future change
delta_context_phys = MAE(context)-MAE(physiology), positive is physiology increment beyond prior level/time
design.uncertainty: Crossed subject×video bootstrap, 5000 replicates, separately by axis/horizon/learner.

decision_rules.CHANGE_SIGNAL_SURVIVES: At least one horizon×axis has BOTH Ridge and HGB delta_context_phys 95% CI strictly above zero. This requires narrowing the paper: physiology may predict deviations despite failing to improve level forecasts.
decision_rules.NO_INCREMENT_FOR_CHANGE: No horizon×axis has delta_context_phys 95% CI strictly above zero for either learner.
decision_rules.ZERO_CHANGE_BEATS_PHYSIOLOGY_STRONGLY: For both axes and all four horizons, both learners have delta_zero_phys mean <=0 and no positive CI.

firewalls: Post-primary; cannot be presented as preregistered confirmation.
A positive change signal does not invalidate the level-prediction result; it changes interpretation.
A null change signal does not imply physiology is causally irrelevant.
next_if_positive: Replicate the positive change horizon/axis externally before manuscript claim.
next_if_nonpositive: Run the same change-target attack on independent POPANE valence and then finalize manuscript-readiness audit.
